risk_flags.reason: Route writes to sacred table `questions`: an UPDATE retiring rows (retired_at/retired_reason='block_regenerated'/is_retired=1) and an INSERT of replacement rows. Both match the DEC-V5-12 enumerated pre-approvals exactly. The UPDATE is scoped to block_id + user_id + retired_at IS NULL (files/app/api/notes/[id]/generate/route.js:52-59); the INSERT is owner-scoped (:62-67). No DELETE on questions exists anywhere in the route. Documentary flag — in-scope, no escalation required.

evidence.claim: Generation selects up to 5 oldest stale blocks ordered stale_since asc, sealed_at asc, id asc (AC1).
AI calls run outside any DB transaction (Promise.all before tx opens); a thrown hard failure returns 502 with no DB writes (AC2).
Retire-not-delete UPDATE matches DEC-V5-12 exact scope: SET retired_at/retired_reason='block_regenerated'/is_retired WHERE block_id = ? AND user_id = ? AND retired_at IS NULL (AC3).
All writes execute inside one db.transaction('write'); the optimistic-concurrency note_blocks bump checks rowsAffected !== 1 and rolls back with a 409 carrying block_id (AC4).
No DELETE statement exists in the route; question rows are only retired or inserted, so session_answers are untouched by construction (AC5).

Verification suite ran and passed 18/18 incl. zero deletes, retired-row scoping to (b1,b2), cross-user untouched, session_answers 2→2 still resolving, forced 409 full rollback, 502 path zero-write, and blast-radius counts (questions 12→21 active+retired, 0 deleted) (AC6).
Sacred-table writes to `questions` (UPDATE retire, INSERT replacements) are pre-approved as enumerated P1C items in TASK_SPEC under DEC-V5-12, with exact scope matching the implemented statements.
Only one file changed (the green-path generate route); no package.json, middleware.js, or migrations touched — no dependency/auth-middleware/schema change to review.
